What changed in this PR This is a security-only `v3.0.2` hotfix on the `release/v3.0.x` line that pins the application runtime, build toolchain, CI, and development environment from Node 20 (EOL) to Node 24.22.1 to pick up the October 2026 Node security release (including CVE-2026-111497 / "Node2Shell"). It intentionally bumps only application version coordinates (root/frontend `package.json`, lockfile, Chart `appVersion`, default image tag) to 3.0.2, deliberately keeping the Helm chart `version` at the historical 3.0.1 (not to be published), and adds a regression guard plus handoff documentation. Exported helper runs CLI checks on import `scripts/ΓÇïcheck-node-runtime.mjs:62` Optional/minor: this guard script runs `checkNodeRuntime(files)` and the negative-control loop unconditionally at module top level, yet it also `export`s `checkNodeRuntime`. That makes the export unusable from a test or other module without triggering the real-file checks, the five negative controls, and the `console.log` as import side effects. This is inconsistent with the sibling script added in this same PR, `scripts/check-changelog-release-lines.mjs`, which exports its functions and guards CLI execution with `if (process.argv[1] && import.meta.url === pathToFileURL(resolve(process.argv[1])).href)` (the same pattern used by `scripts/run-remote-completionist-award-iii.mjs` and `scripts/write-build-meta.mjs`). Consider wrapping the top-level invocation (lines 49-82) in that CLI guard so the exported function can be imported/tested in isolation, or drop the `export` if isolated importing isn't intended.
Review effort: Balanced
